visual_review: Lead review of real engine captures (not the concept image). Better than before: licensed car with panel gaps, interior and Turkish-layout plate; mosque with relief, drum, turrets and fluted minarets; 3D bridge, far shore and ferry; houses with casings, shutters, awnings; wet road mirrors lamps and mosque at night; HUD with live data. Still weak, not accepted as final: houses read plain in daylight from 8-40 m, roofs are slabs; mosque stone is flat cream by day; no spectators (flat cards removed as toy-like); no rain beads on paint; rivals are still the older procedural cars in this capture. Gate score by the lead about 70/100, target 90 not reached. The owner decides acceptance.
device: Desktop PC, Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB, 1920x1080, High preset. Not an iPhone measurement.
perf_note: Night gameplay shot (bench_night_gameplay.json): 302 fps average, frame 3.31 ms avg, 4.14 ms p95, 377 draw calls, 373532 primitives. Sunset gameplay 342 fps / 2.92 ms. Day gameplay 430 fps / 2.32 ms. Uncapped desktop numbers over 60 frames; they say nothing about iPhone.
